violation_type.title: NYC Health Code §47.27(f)
violation_type.typical_finding: Permittee must isolate or exclude children and staff suspected, confirmed or exposed to communicable disease in accordance with HC Article 11. Excluded individuals must have medical provider documentation that they are free of disease and can return. Exclusion must be reported to DOHMH.
